kind: exploratory pilot probes (excluded from the 5-trial table)
why: The exact-length harness and the cache's cold-isolation semantics had to be verified before spending the sweep; a wrong assumption here would silently invalidate every cell.

findings.claim: tax law on a verified hit

findings.evidence: three independent tests: novel prompt -> prompt_tokens_details=null; same body but different first word (L=1022) -> null; same body sent again after three intervening requests -> null (L=979). Prefix match starts at token 0, as U9 assumed.

findings.claim: the immediate repeat can miss or be partial
findings.evidence: fresh body b2 (L=965) then a same-body/different-tail request sent immediately -> cached=0; a 1024-token cell's first repeat -> cached=768 (12 of 15 blocks) with TTFT 129.5 ms against a 215.8 ms cold

findings.claim: an intervening request or ~1 s can make the hit appear
findings.evidence: L=1003 repeat after 3 intervening requests -> cached=960, TTFT 85.7 ms; L=958 repeat after 1.0 s sleep -> 896 (896 is the tax-law value, so full)

findings.claim: pilot anomaly, fully explained, forces verified-cold starts
findings.evidence: three prompts with different markers each reported cached=960; cause: the pilot scripts all started their marker sequence at SEED*1000+1, so pilot #2 reused pilot #1's markers and its longer body extended a cached prefix. Live run now starts a million seeds later and retries any request that reports a non-zero cache on a cold role.
